basic_info.description: This thoughtfully designed & recently renovated, 1500 sq ft top-floor flat is situated in a boutique 3-unit association and features 4 skylights throughout. The exceptionally large master bedroom boasts an en-suite bathroom & a beautiful west view of Twin Peaks. A spacious second bedroom doubles as an ideal home office, with quiet surroundings & natural light from the interior atrium. The kitchen comes complete, outfitted with luxurious quartz countertops, stainless steel appliances, & beautiful wood cabinetry. The breakfast nook opens directly onto a large, private, east-facing deck, accessible from the nook and the living room, overlooking a spectacularly manicured shared garden. The living room is perfect for entertaining guests by the stylish wet bar, or for evenings by the wood-burning fireplace. The seamless flow between dining room, kitchen, & living room allows for serene views of the greenhouse window overlooking the atrium. Included are an in-unit washer & dryer, generous closets, & storage spaces throughout. Secure deeded garage parking with extra storage space for bikes, strollers, & more. Ideally located within walking distance of Hayes Valley, Alamo Square, & Lower Haight, offering some of the best dining, shopping, & art the city has to offer. Great for commuters!
